d.synopsis:
"Pyaaaaaahhhh!!!"

Thrown together out of the blue to make their debut, these members each have a spark of unique talent—but they are in absolutely no shape to actually be a band.

Can these girls, and their band, really survive this!?

"Even when the sound stops, fight back."
